subject: an issue with the network connection

messages.author: 8530c3a3878bc397
messages.subject: an issue with the network connection
parts:
Hi, here is an issue of Shiny apps: if the user access the app through some certain WIFI connections, the app shows part of the page but will soon gray out. The error message is something like '"...websocket was interrupted while the page was loading.". Several people have reported this issue. Jeff Allen mentioned  he had a fix in mind.

Is this issue solved? Jeff, may I have a quick solution to fix the bug without waiting for the next release? I got too many complains over my app and really want to fix it. Many thanks!

AN

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: an issue with the network connection
parts:
Hi,

We've resolved one portion of the issues, but it seems that some are still seeing this problem. A few questions that would help us diagnose:

1.) How long is the page active before it times out for you?
2.) What messages are available in the console when you get disconnected?
3.) What browser(s) do you notice this on?
4.) Try disabling Web Sockets (using Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A) as described here: http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#specifying-protocols). Does that fix the issue or change the error message?

Thanks,
Jeff

parts: Thanks for all this information -- very helpful.
4. I am sorry but I cannot get the window that will allow me to select protocols. :-(

One more question: can you specify which connections you are or are not seeing this on? The more information the better -- it seems like certain service providers (or coffee shop chains) exhibit this behavior but others don't. If we're able to pin down what's common between the connections that have this problem, we'll be in a much better position to solve it. Are you -- or the users that are having trouble -- confined to a particular part of the world?

Thanks tons!
Jeff
